body: <sf-language id="compact" languages="ru en de" compact size="1/2" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="five" languages="ru en de fr es" size="1/2"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="twelve" languages="ru en de fr es it pt tr pl uk ja ar" size="1/2" apply="none"></sf-language>
<sf-language id="forced" languages="ru en de fr es" mode="inline" apply="none"></sf-language>
<form id="settings"><sf-language id="field" name="language" languages="ru en de fr" value="de" apply="none"></sf-language></form>

checks.title: two languages are a segmented switch named «Язык»: a radio per language, in its own name and its own lang, the page's language chosen
checks.covers: settings.languages, look inline, accessibility radiogroup, settings.label

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#two'); const group = el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-language-parts > sf-button-group'); const radios = [...el.querySelectorAll('button[role="radio"]')]; return el.getAttribute('data-look') === 'inline' && group.getAttribute('appearance') === 'segmented' && el.querySelector('[role="radiogroup"]').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Язык' && radios.length === 2 && radios[0].textContent.trim() === 'Русский' && radios[0].lang === 'ru' && radios[1].textContent.trim() === 'English' && radios[1].lang === 'en' && radios[0].getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' && el.value === 'ru'; })()

checks.title: a press on English sends one change {value en, previous ru}; the page takes it: SF.language, lang and dir on <html>
a cancelled change leaves everything as it was: the value, the page's language and the switch's plate

steps.script: (window.__stop = (event) => { if (event.target.id === 'two') event.preventDefault(); }, window.addEventListener('change', window.__stop, true), document.querySelector('#two button[role="radio"][lang="en"]').click(), true)

checks.title: compact shows the codes; each segment keeps the language's name as its accessible name

steps.check: (() => { const radios = [...document.querySelectorAll('#compact button[role="radio"]')]; return radios.map((b) => b.textContent.trim()).join(' ') === 'RU EN DE' && radios[2].getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Deutsch' && radios[2].lang === 'de'; })()

checks.title: five languages are the «translate» icon button named «Язык: Русский» and a menu of radio rows: the name in itself, English beside it, each row in its language
checks.covers: look menu, accessibility trigger name, icon translate

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#five'); const button = el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-language-parts > sf-button-icon button'); return el.getAttribute('data-look') === 'menu' && button.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Язык: Русский' && button.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'menu' && el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-language-parts > sf-button-icon').getAttribute('icon') === 'translate' && !el.querySelector('sf-button-group'); })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#five sf-menu-context [role="menuitemradio"]')]; const de = rows.find((row) => row.lang === 'de'); return rows.length === 5 && de.querySelector('.sf-context-menu-item-label').textContent.trim() === 'Deutsch' && de.querySelector('.sf-context-menu-item-value').textContent.trim() === 'German' && rows[0].getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' && !rows[1].querySelector('.sf-context-menu-item-value') && document.querySelector('#five sf-button-icon button').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'; })()

document.documentElement.lang === 'de' && document.querySelector('#five sf-button-icon button').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Language: Deutsch' && document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#five sf-button-icon button')

checks.title: twelve languages open the menu with a search field; «нем», «German» and «de» each find Deutsch alone
checks.covers: look search, the menu's search, keywords

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#twelve'); const field = el.querySelector('.sf-context-menu-search-input'); return el.getAttribute('data-look') === 'search' && field && document.activeElement === field && field.placeholder === 'Найти язык' && el.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitemradio"]').length === 12; })()

steps.script: (() => { const menu = document.querySelector('#twelve sf-menu-context'); const found = (query) => { menu.setQuery(query); return new Promise((done) => requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(() => done([...menu.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitemradio"]')].map((row) => row.lang).join(' ')), 60))); }; return (async () => [await found('нем'), await found('German'), await found('de'), await found('zz')].join('|'))(); })()

steps.check: document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#twelve sf-button-icon button') && document.querySelector('#twelve sf-button-icon button').getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true'

checks.title: Arabic is applied right to left: dir rtl on <html>, the change says so; Russian puts ltr back
a language with an href is followed, not applied, and remember keeps the code
one language draws nothing; mode inline keeps five languages in a switch

steps.check: (() => { const one = document.querySelector('#one'); const forced = document.querySelector('#forced'); return one.getAttribute('data-look') === 'none' && one.children.length === 0 && forced.getAttribute('data-look') === 'inline' && forced.querySelectorAll('button[role="radio"]').length === 5 && forced.look === 'inline'; })()

checks.title: items gives a language its own label; the list is read from the island

steps.check: (() => { const radios = [...document.querySelectorAll('#named button[role="radio"]')]; return radios.length === 2 && radios[0].textContent.trim() === 'Қазақ тілі' && radios[0].lang === 'kk' && document.querySelector('#named').value === 'ru'; })()

checks.title: in a form the element submits its code by name; a press changes it, reset brings back the written value
